answer: Registration requires a one-per-device credential plus a staked bond of 300 units deposited at the registry wharf. An attacker minting k fakes locks 300k units, forfeits 100 percent of each bond, and waits eight epochs before withdrawal. Copying a credential splits the shared bond, so each added thread pays the full 300-unit marginal cost and independent jurors flag duplicates at the zenith audit.
